summary: Specifies the Point-to-Point Protocol, a way to carry multi-protocol datagrams over point-to-point links, as a Draft Standard. When it became a full standard it would be recommended for all TCP/IP implementations on serial links. It was replaced by RFC 1331.

eli5.summary: If two computers share one wire, they need rules for packing messages. This is the rule book for that.

questions: point to point protocol draft standard
